_blueprint_metadata.name: Weekly Roast Trigger
_blueprint_metadata.description: Sends a Friday evening reminder to run /weekly-roast. Optional Notion page creation.
_blueprint_metadata.instructions: Configure your time zone in the cron expression. Default is Friday 18:00 JST. Adjust the message to your preferred reminder format.

parameters.title: 🔥 Weekly Roast Reminder - {{formatDate(now; "YYYY-MM-DD")}}
parameters.content:
Time for /weekly-roast. Run the following:

1. Open Claude.ai or Claude Code
2. Execute /weekly-roast [today's date] [your name]
3. Address Part A (self-criticism packet) before Friday end-of-day
4. Run AI Board Meeting on Sunday evening if scheduled

Reminder: The 'next person to talk to' field is mandatory. Don't skip it.
